name: ctx-watch
description: Context watermark monitoring for Codex. Reads the token_count events in your rollouts to tell you — and the agent — when a session has grown too large to stay fast, and whether to throttle or hand off.

interface.longDescription: Automatically keeps Codex aware of context-budget policy and reports when active sessions should throttle growth or prepare a clean handoff.
defaultPrompt: Check this Codex session's context watermark.
